import { arisWeaponSettings, attackTimeFormula, supernovaSkillSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { statMultiplier, ensureCombatStats, rollAttackDamage, totalWeaponDamage } from './combat-stats.js';
import { getAllEnemies, getEnemy, damageEnemy } from './world-state.js';
import { getCombatHitbox, segmentHitsBody } from './combat-hitboxes.js';
import { applySkillControl } from './enemy-control.js';

/** Create Supernova with independent automatic and EX attacks. */
export function createArisWeapon() {
  return { id: 'aris-laser', name: 'Supernova', icon: '../sprites/attacks/Weapon_Icon_Arisu.png',
    level: 1, exSkill: true };
}

/** Find the equipped laser, independently of every other automatic weapon. */
export function getArisWeapon(player) {
  return player.attackSlots?.find(weapon => weapon?.id === 'aris-laser');
}

/** Size bonuses add to base width; level7 adds a rear beam to each volley. */
export function arisLevelStats(player) {
  const level = Math.max(1, Math.min(7, getArisWeapon(player)?.level || 1));
  return { level, size: 1 + (level >= 2 ? .3 : 0) + (level >= 6 ? .5 : 0),
    damage: level >= 4 ? 1.5 : 1,
    interval: arisWeaponSettings.attackInterval - (level >= 3 ? .5 : 0) - (level >= 5 ? .5 : 0),
    beams: level >= 7 ? 2 : 1 };
}

/** Roll the supplied27-33base damage range, then weapon levels and player ATK/crit. */
export function rollArisDamage(player, random = Math.random, target, damageMod = 1) {
  const s = arisWeaponSettings;
  return rollAttackDamage(player, totalWeaponDamage(player, 'aris-laser', s.damageMultiplier,
    [(arisLevelStats(player).damage - 1) * 100],
    { projectileCount: arisLevelStats(player).beams, hitCooldownFrames: s.hitCooldown * 60 }), random, { target, damageMod });
}

/** Unlimited piercing capsule; every enemy still observes its own hit cooldown. */
export function arisBeamHits(enemy, origin, angle, width, length = arisWeaponSettings.beamLength) {
  const body = getCombatHitbox(enemy, true);
  return segmentHitsBody({ ...body, rx: body.rx + width / 2, ry: body.ry + width / 2 },
    origin.x + Math.cos(angle) * supernovaSkillSettings.originOffset, origin.y + Math.sin(angle) * supernovaSkillSettings.originOffset, origin.x + Math.cos(angle) * length, origin.y + Math.sin(angle) * length);
}

/** Own an independent automatic laser cycle alongside all other equipped autoattacks. */
export function createArisAttack() {
  let special = null;
  let owner = null, cooldown = 0, clock = 0, volleys = [];
  const hitTimes = new Map();
  function clear() { special = null; owner = null; cooldown = 0; clock = 0; volleys = []; hitTimes.clear(); }
  const s = arisWeaponSettings;
  const image = new Image();
  image.src = new URL('../sprites/attacks/Weapon_Icon_Arisu.png', import.meta.url).href;
  const ready = image.decode();
  return {
    ready,
    reset: clear,
    /** Start a continuous, independently aimable EX; shared per-target cooldown prevents frame damage. */
    cast(player, angle, damageMultiplier = 1.5, getAngle = () => angle) {
      if (owner !== player) { clear(); owner = player; }
      special = { player, angle, getAngle, damageMultiplier, elapsed: 0, hits: new Map() };
    },
    update(delta, player, aim) {
      if (!getArisWeapon(player)) { clear(); return; }
      if (owner !== player) { clear(); owner = player; }
      clock += delta;
      if (special) {
        special.elapsed += delta;
        special.angle = special.getAngle();
        if (special.elapsed >= supernovaSkillSettings.duration || special.player !== player) special = null;
      }
      for (const [id, time] of hitTimes) if (clock-time > s.hitCooldown+s.beamSeconds) hitTimes.delete(id);
      cooldown = Math.max(0, cooldown - delta);
      if (cooldown <= 0) {
        const stats = arisLevelStats(player);
        volleys.push({ elapsed: 0, angles: stats.beams === 2 ? [aim, aim + Math.PI] : [aim],
          width: s.beamWidth * stats.size, origin: { x: player.x, y: player.y } });
        cooldown = attackTimeFormula(stats.interval, ensureCombatStats(player).hastePercent);
      }
      const active = [...volleys];
      if (special) active.push({ elapsed: special.elapsed, angles: [special.angle], width: s.beamWidth * arisLevelStats(player).size * 2,
        origin: { x: player.x, y: player.y }, special: true });
      for (const volley of active) {
        const start = volley.elapsed;
        volley.elapsed += delta;
        volley.origin = { x: player.x, y: player.y };
        if (volley.special || start < s.beamSeconds) for (const enemy of getAllEnemies()) {
          const times = volley.special ? special.hits : hitTimes;
          const lastHit = times.get(enemy.id);
          if (lastHit !== undefined && clock - lastHit < (volley.special ? supernovaSkillSettings.hitCooldown : s.hitCooldown) - 1e-8) continue;
          const angle = volley.angles.find(value => arisBeamHits(enemy, volley.origin, value, volley.width));
          if (angle === undefined) continue;
          times.set(enemy.id, clock); // A missed attack also cannot reroll every frame.
          const hit = rollArisDamage(player, Math.random, enemy, volley.special ? special.damageMultiplier : 1);
          const landed = damageEnemy(enemy.id, hit.damage, player, hit.type, { canMiss: true });
          const living = getEnemy(enemy.id);
          if (landed !== false && living) {
            if (volley.special) {
              const control = supernovaKnockback(living, volley.origin, angle, volley.width);
              applySkillControl(living, control.x, control.y, supernovaSkillSettings.knockbackSeconds,
                supernovaSkillSettings.knockbackSeconds,
                { ignoreKnockbackResistance: supernovaSkillSettings.ignoreKnockbackResistance });
            } else {
              const distance = s.knockbackSpeed * s.knockbackSeconds;
              applySkillControl(living, Math.cos(angle) * distance, Math.sin(angle) * distance,
                s.knockbackSeconds, s.knockbackSeconds, { ignoreKnockbackResistance: s.ignoreKnockbackResistance });
            }
          }
        }
      }
      volleys = volleys.filter(volley => volley.elapsed < s.beamSeconds);
    },
    draw(context, camera) {
      const visible = [...volleys];
      if (special) visible.push({ elapsed: special.elapsed, angles: [special.angle], origin: special.player,
        width: s.beamWidth * arisLevelStats(special.player).size * 2, special: true });
      for (const volley of visible) {
        const duration = volley.special ? supernovaSkillSettings.duration : s.beamSeconds;
        const thickness = Math.min(1, volley.elapsed / .025, (duration - volley.elapsed) / .12);
        for (const angle of volley.angles) {
          context.save();
          context.translate(volley.origin.x - camera.x, volley.origin.y - camera.y);
          context.rotate(angle);
          const offset = supernovaSkillSettings.originOffset;
          for (const [scale, color, blur] of [[2, '#219bff88', 9], [1.25, '#51e6ff', 3], [.55, '#f1ffff', 0]]) {
            const half = volley.width * scale * Math.max(0, thickness) / 2;
            context.filter = blur ? `blur(${blur}px)` : 'none';
            context.fillStyle = color;
            context.beginPath(); context.moveTo(offset, 0);
            context.lineTo(offset + 45, -half); context.lineTo(s.beamLength, -half);
            context.lineTo(s.beamLength, half); context.lineTo(offset + 45, half);
            context.closePath(); context.fill();
          }
          context.restore();
        }
      }
    }
  };
}


/** Sweep toward the closest beam edge, plus a small forward shove.
 * Include projected body radius so even large enemies clear the beam at zero resistance.
 * Shared knockback still respects resistance, collisions and absolute immunity.
 */
export function supernovaKnockback(enemy, origin, angle, width) {
  const body = getCombatHitbox(enemy, true);
  const forwardX = Math.cos(angle), forwardY = Math.sin(angle);
  const sideX = -forwardY, sideY = forwardX;
  const offset = (body.x-origin.x)*sideX + (body.y-origin.y)*sideY;
  const sign = offset < 0 ? -1 : 1;
  const radius = Math.hypot(body.rx*sideX, body.ry*sideY);
  const distance = Math.max(0, width/2 + radius + supernovaSkillSettings.knockbackClearance - Math.abs(offset));
  return {
    x: sideX*sign*distance + forwardX*supernovaSkillSettings.forwardKnockback,
    y: sideY*sign*distance + forwardY*supernovaSkillSettings.forwardKnockback
  };
}

/** Sweep toward the closest beam edge, plus a small forward shove.
 * Include projected body radius so even large enemies clear the beam at zero resistance.
 * Shared knockback still respects resistance, collisions and absolute immunity.
 */
export function supernovaKnockback(enemy, origin, angle, width) {
  const body = getCombatHitbox(enemy, true);
  const forwardX = Math.cos(angle), forwardY = Math.sin(angle);
  const sideX = -forwardY, sideY = forwardX;
  const offset = (body.x-origin.x)*sideX + (body.y-origin.y)*sideY;
  const sign = offset < 0 ? -1 : 1;
  const radius = Math.hypot(body.rx*sideX, body.ry*sideY);
  const distance = Math.max(0, width/2 + radius + supernovaSkillSettings.knockbackClearance - Math.abs(offset));

// Elite size, HP and spawn chance are configured in game-config.js.





/** Roll basic-enemy elites; bosses and playable-character test NPCs are excluded. */
export function enemyVariant(type, template, mode = 'random', random = Math.random, survivalSeconds = 0, endlessSeconds = null, eliteProbability = eliteChanceFormula(endlessSeconds)) {
  const elite = type === 'midori' || (type === 'mob' || template.standard) && (mode === 'elite' || (mode === 'random' && random() < eliteProbability));
  const baseHp = (['mob', 'midori'].includes(type) || template.standard) ? basicMobHpFormula(survivalSeconds)
    : type === 'shiroko' ? mobBaseHp * shirokoBossStats.hpMultiplier : combatBalance.otherEnemyHp;
  const maxHp = baseHp * (elite ? combatBalance.eliteHpMultiplier : 1);
  return {
    elite,
    label: elite ? `Elite ${template.label}` : template.label,
    spriteSize: (template.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) * (elite && type !== 'midori' ? eliteSizeMultiplier : 1),
    hp: maxHp,
    maxHp,
    contactDamage: type === 'shiroko' ? shirokoBossStats.contactDamage : template.contactDamage,
    contactDamageMultiplier: elite ? 2 : 1
  };
}

/** Pick from the configured standard enemy pool while keeping Mob most common. */
export function chooseStandardEnemy(random = Math.random) {
  const entries = Object.entries(standardEnemyWeights).filter(([, weight]) => weight > 0);
  let roll = random() * entries.reduce((sum, [, weight]) => sum + weight, 0);
  for (const [type, weight] of entries) { roll -= weight; if (roll < 0) return type; }
  return entries.at(-1)?.[0] || 'mob';
}

import { enemyContactDamageFormula } from './game-config.js';
import { yuukaSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { contactSettings } from './game-config.js';
export { contactSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { getCombatHitbox } from './combat-hitboxes.js';
import { damagePlayer } from './player-stats.js';
import { beginKnockback, advanceKnockback } from './knockback.js';

// Contact reaction settings live in game-config.js.
/** Detect player pass-through with a swept segment rather than endpoint overlap only. */
function contactGeometry(npc, player, motion) {
  const enemyBody = getCombatHitbox(npc, true), playerBody = getCombatHitbox(player, false);
  const rx = enemyBody.rx + playerBody.rx, ry = enemyBody.ry + playerBody.ry;
  const fromX = playerBody.x - motion.x, fromY = playerBody.y - motion.y;
  const lengthSquared = motion.x * motion.x + motion.y * motion.y;
  const scaledLength = (motion.x / rx) ** 2 + (motion.y / ry) ** 2;
  const t = scaledLength ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1,
    ((enemyBody.x - fromX) * motion.x / rx ** 2 +
      (enemyBody.y - fromY) * motion.y / ry ** 2) / scaledLength)) : 1;
  const dx = enemyBody.x - (fromX + motion.x * t);
  const dy = enemyBody.y - (fromY + motion.y * t);
  const distance = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
  const pushing = lengthSquared > 0.0001 &&
    motion.x * (npc.x - fromX) + motion.y * (npc.y - fromY) > 0;
  // At exact overlap, push along player travel; otherwise away from the player.
  const fallbackLength = Math.hypot(motion.x, motion.y) || 1;
  const nx = distance > 0.001 ? dx / distance : lengthSquared ? motion.x / fallbackLength : 1;
  const ny = distance > 0.001 ? dy / distance : lengthSquared ? motion.y / fallbackLength : 0;
  const radius = 1 / Math.hypot(nx / rx, ny / ry);
  return { touching: (dx / rx) ** 2 + (dy / ry) ** 2 < 1, pushing, radius, nx, ny,
    overlap: Math.max(0, radius - Math.hypot(enemyBody.x - playerBody.x, enemyBody.y - playerBody.y)) };
}

/** React to contact, flash once, and pause chase until bounce/push recovery ends. */
export function updateNpcContact(npc, player, motion, delta, move, survivalSeconds = 0) {
  npc.contactCooldown = Math.max(0, (npc.contactCooldown || 0) - delta);
  // Per-enemy attack cooldown is separate from recoil and the player's global I-frames.
  npc.playerHitCooldown = Math.max(0, (npc.playerHitCooldown || 0) - delta);
  const hit = contactGeometry(npc, player, motion);
  if (hit.touching && !(player.contactIFrames > 0) && !(npc.playerHitCooldown > 0)) {
    const baseDamage = npc.contactDamage ?? (npc.type === 'mob' ? contactSettings.mobDamage : contactSettings.playerDamage);
    const damage = enemyContactDamageFormula(baseDamage, player.level || 1,
      survivalSeconds, npc.contactDamageMultiplier ?? 1);
    const damaged = damagePlayer(player, damage);
    if (damaged && npc.type === 'yuuka') npc.playerHitCooldown = yuukaSettings.contactHitInterval;
    if (damaged) player.contactIFrames = contactSettings.iFrameDuration;
  }
  const overrideBounce = npc.contactReaction?.kind === 'bounce' && hit.pushing;
  if (hit.touching && ((!npc.contactReaction && !npc.contactCooldown) || overrideBounce)) {
    const kind = hit.pushing ? 'push' : 'bounce';
    const settings = contactSettings[kind];
    const overlap = hit.overlap;
    const knockback = beginKnockback(npc, hit.nx * (settings.distance + overlap),
      hit.ny * (settings.distance + overlap), settings.travel);
    npc.contactReaction = knockback ? { ...knockback, kind, nx: hit.nx, ny: hit.ny } : null;
    if (!knockback) npc.contactCooldown = contactSettings.cooldown;
    npc.attack = null;
  }
  const reaction = npc.contactReaction;
  if (!reaction) return false;
  const settings = contactSettings[reaction.kind];
  advanceKnockback(npc, reaction, delta, move);
  const pauseChase = npc.contactRecoveryDelay !== false;
  if (pauseChase) npc.moving = false;
  const recovery = pauseChase ? settings.recovery : settings.travel;
import { basicMobHpFormula, eliteChanceFormula } from './game-config.js';
import { standardEnemyWeights } from './game-config.js';
import { combatBalance } from './game-config.js';
import { eliteSizeMultiplier, eliteChance, mobBaseHp, shirokoBossStats } from './game-config.js';
export { eliteSizeMultiplier, eliteChance, mobBaseHp, shirokoBossStats } from './game-config.js';
import { normalSpriteSize } from './scene-metrics.js';

// Elite size, HP and spawn chance are configured in game-config.js.





/** Roll basic-enemy elites; bosses and playable-character test NPCs are excluded. */
export function enemyVariant(type, template, mode = 'random', random = Math.random, survivalSeconds = 0, endlessSeconds = null, eliteProbability = eliteChanceFormula(endlessSeconds)) {
  const elite = type === 'midori' || (type === 'mob' || template.standard) && (mode === 'elite' || (mode === 'random' && random() < eliteProbability));
  const baseHp = (['mob', 'midori'].includes(type) || template.standard) ? basicMobHpFormula(survivalSeconds)
    : type === 'shiroko' ? mobBaseHp * shirokoBossStats.hpMultiplier : combatBalance.otherEnemyHp;
  const maxHp = baseHp * (elite ? combatBalance.eliteHpMultiplier : 1);
  return {
    elite,
    label: elite ? `Elite ${template.label}` : template.label,
    spriteSize: (template.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) * (elite && type !== 'midori' ? eliteSizeMultiplier : 1),
    hp: maxHp,
    maxHp,
    contactDamage: type === 'shiroko' ? shirokoBossStats.contactDamage : template.contactDamage,
    contactDamageMultiplier: elite ? 2 : 1
  };
}

import { basicMobHpFormula, eliteChanceFormula } from './game-config.js';
import { standardEnemyWeights } from './game-config.js';
import { combatBalance } from './game-config.js';
import { eliteSizeMultiplier, eliteChance, mobBaseHp, shirokoBossStats } from './game-config.js';
export { eliteSizeMultiplier, eliteChance, mobBaseHp, shirokoBossStats } from './game-config.js';
import { normalSpriteSize } from './scene-metrics.js';

// Elite size, HP and spawn chance are configured in game-config.js.





/** Roll basic-enemy elites; bosses and playable-character test NPCs are excluded. */
export function enemyVariant(type, template, mode = 'random', random = Math.random, survivalSeconds = 0, endlessSeconds = null, eliteProbability = eliteChanceFormula(endlessSeconds)) {
  const elite = type === 'midori' || (type === 'mob' || template.standard) && (mode === 'elite' || (mode === 'random' && random() < eliteProbability));
  const baseHp = (['mob', 'midori'].includes(type) || template.standard) ? basicMobHpFormula(survivalSeconds)
    : type === 'shiroko' ? mobBaseHp * shirokoBossStats.hpMultiplier : combatBalance.otherEnemyHp;
  const maxHp = baseHp * (elite ? combatBalance.eliteHpMultiplier : 1);
  return {
    elite,
    label: elite ? `Elite ${template.label}` : template.label,
    spriteSize: (template.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) * (elite && type !== 'midori' ? eliteSizeMultiplier : 1),
    hp: maxHp,
    maxHp,
    contactDamage: type === 'shiroko' ? shirokoBossStats.contactDamage : template.contactDamage,
    contactDamageMultiplier: elite ? 2 : 1
  };
}

/** Pick from the configured standard enemy pool while keeping Mob most common. */
export function chooseStandardEnemy(random = Math.random) {
  const entries = Object.entries(standardEnemyWeights).filter(([, weight]) => weight > 0);
  let roll = random() * entries.reduce((sum, [, weight]) => sum + weight, 0);
  for (const [type, weight] of entries) { roll -= weight; if (roll < 0) return type; }
  return entries.at(-1)?.[0] || 'mob';
}

    }
    const size = variant.spriteSize;
    x = !options.automatic && isVertical() ? Math.max(camera.x + size / 2, Math.min(camera.x + canvas.width - size / 2, x)) : x;

      x: !options.automatic && isVertical() ? Math.max(camera.x + size / 2, Math.min(camera.x + canvas.width - size / 2, x)) : x,
      y: options.automatic || isVertical() || isFreeScroll() ? y : Math.max(camera.y + size / 2, Math.min(camera.y + canvas.height - size / 2, y)),
      direction: template.defaultDirection || 'down', facing: template.defaultDirection || 'left',
      moving: false, elapsed: 0, attack: null, transition: null, lastPose: null,
      movementSpeedMultiplier: type === 'midori' ? midoriSpeed(getPlayer(), baseMovementSpeed) / baseMovementSpeed
        : ['yuuka','sensei'].includes(type) ? yuukaSettings.speed / baseMovementSpeed : playerSettings.npcSpeed / baseMovementSpeed,
      ai: options.ai ?? field('npc-ai').checked, behavior: ['yuuka','sensei'].includes(type) ? 'erratic' : options.behavior ?? field('npc-behavior').value,
      wanderTimer: 0, wanderDirection: undefined, invincible: false,
      combatStats: {}, // NPCs do not inherit the controlled avatar's test upgrades.
      ...variant,
      // Default rewards roll on defeat; explicit admin overrides remain available.
      expReward: !options.automatic && field('npc-exp-override').checked
        ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1000000, Math.floor(Number(field('npc-exp').value) || 0))) : variant.expReward
    });
    if (!options.automatic) selectedId = npc.id;
    return true;
  }

    let removed = trimEnemyPopulation(getPlayer());
    removed += despawnDistantEnemies(camera, canvas.width, canvas.height, isPlacementClear);
    if (removed) refresh();
    return removed;
  }

  return { update, draw: () => draw('normal'), drawSpecials: () => draw('special'), drawBosses: () => draw('boss'), refresh, cleanup, getEnemies: records,
    slotsRemaining: () => Math.max(0, cap - records().length),
    spawnBoss: (type, x, y) => spawn(x, y, { type, variant: 'normal', ai: true, behavior: 'chase', automatic: true }),
    spawnEnemy: (x, y, forcedType, eventKey) => {
      if (forcedType === 'midori') return spawn(x, y, { type: 'midori', eventKey, ai: true, behavior: 'chase', automatic: true });
      // Harmless enemies now use scheduled rolls, never ordinary kill/arrival rolls.
      return spawn(x, y, { type: chooseStandardEnemy(), eventKey, variant: 'random', ai: true, behavior: 'chase', automatic: true });
    } };
}

/** Roll basic-enemy elites; bosses and playable-character test NPCs are excluded. */
export function enemyVariant(type, template, mode = 'random', random = Math.random, survivalSeconds = 0, endlessSeconds = null, eliteProbability = eliteChanceFormula(endlessSeconds)) {
  const elite = type === 'midori' || (type === 'mob' || template.standard) && (mode === 'elite' || (mode === 'random' && random() < eliteProbability));
  const baseHp = (['mob', 'midori'].includes(type) || template.standard) ? basicMobHpFormula(survivalSeconds)
    : type === 'shiroko' ? mobBaseHp * shirokoBossStats.hpMultiplier : combatBalance.otherEnemyHp;
  const profile = enemyTypeStats[type];
  const scaled = profile ? enemyStatsScalingFormula(profile, campaignScalingTimeFormula(endlessSeconds)) : null;
  const maxHp = (scaled?.hp ?? baseHp) * (elite ? combatBalance.eliteHpMultiplier : 1);
  return {
    elite,
    label: elite ? `Elite ${template.label}` : template.label,
    spriteSize: (template.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) * (elite && type !== 'midori' ? eliteSizeMultiplier : 1),
    hp: maxHp,
    maxHp,
    contactDamage: type === 'shiroko' ? shirokoBossStats.contactDamage : template.contactDamage,
    contactDamageMultiplier: elite ? 2 : 1,
    ...(profile ? { hp: Math.round(maxHp), maxHp: Math.round(maxHp), perTypeStats: true,
      contactDamage: scaled.atk, expReward: profile.expValue,
      movementSpeedMultiplier: scaled.spd * playerSettings.speed / playerSettings.movementBase } : {})
  };
}

import { basicMobHpFormula, eliteChanceFormula } from './game-config.js';
import { standardEnemyWeights, enemyTypeStats, playerSettings, enemyStatsScalingFormula, campaignScalingTimeFormula } from './game-config.js';
import { combatBalance } from './game-config.js';
import { eliteSizeMultiplier, eliteChance, mobBaseHp, shirokoBossStats } from './game-config.js';
export { eliteSizeMultiplier, eliteChance, mobBaseHp, shirokoBossStats } from './game-config.js';
import { normalSpriteSize } from './scene-metrics.js';

// Elite size, HP and spawn chance are configured in game-config.js.





/** Roll basic-enemy elites; bosses and playable-character test NPCs are excluded. */
export function enemyVariant(type, template, mode = 'random', random = Math.random, survivalSeconds = 0, endlessSeconds = null, eliteProbability = eliteChanceFormula(endlessSeconds)) {
  const elite = type === 'midori' || (type === 'mob' || template.standard) && (mode === 'elite' || (mode === 'random' && random() < eliteProbability));
  const baseHp = (['mob', 'midori'].includes(type) || template.standard) ? basicMobHpFormula(survivalSeconds)
    : type === 'shiroko' ? mobBaseHp * shirokoBossStats.hpMultiplier : combatBalance.otherEnemyHp;
  const profile = enemyTypeStats[type];
  const scaled = profile ? enemyStatsScalingFormula(profile, campaignScalingTimeFormula(endlessSeconds)) : null;
  const maxHp = (scaled?.hp ?? baseHp) * (elite ? combatBalance.eliteHpMultiplier : 1);
  return {
    elite,
    label: elite ? `Elite ${template.label}` : template.label,
    spriteSize: (template.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) * (elite && type !== 'midori' ? eliteSizeMultiplier : 1),
    hp: maxHp,
    maxHp,
    contactDamage: type === 'shiroko' ? shirokoBossStats.contactDamage : template.contactDamage,
    contactDamageMultiplier: elite ? 2 : 1,
    ...(profile ? { hp: Math.round(maxHp), maxHp: Math.round(maxHp), perTypeStats: true,
      contactDamage: scaled.atk, expReward: profile.expValue,
      movementSpeedMultiplier: scaled.spd * playerSettings.speed / playerSettings.movementBase } : {})
  };
}

    const profile = enemyTypeStats[type];
    return weight > 0 && (!profile || (elapsedSeconds >= profile.spawnStartSeconds && elapsedSeconds < profile.spawnEndSeconds));
import { enemyTypeStats, megaMobSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { combatHitboxes } from './combat-hitboxes.js';
import { normalSpriteSize } from './scene-metrics.js';

/** Mega Mob shares Mob's animation and body geometry, enlarged for mini-boss visibility. */
export function createMegaMob(template) {
  return {...template,label:'Mega Mob',miniBoss:true,boss:false,standard:false,special:true,
    spriteSize:(template.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize)*megaMobSettings.sizeMultiplier,
    combatHitbox:combatHitboxes.mob};
}

/** Retry blocked/full-population placements; consume the one-shot only on success. */
export function createMiniBossSchedule() {
  const spawned = new Set();
  return { update(seconds, spawn) {
    for (const [type, profile] of Object.entries(enemyTypeStats)) {
      if (profile.spawnAtSeconds == null || seconds < profile.spawnAtSeconds || spawned.has(type)) continue;
      if (spawn(type)) spawned.add(type);
    }
  }};
}

import { bossChanceFormula, bossPityThresholds } from './game-config.js';
import { bossSpawnSettings } from './game-config.js';
export { bossSpawnSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { bossSpriteSize } from './scene-metrics.js';
import { getAllEnemies, isBossEnemy, onEnemySpawn, onEnemyDefeat } from './world-state.js';
import { offscreenSpawnPoint } from './playtest-spawner.js';



/** Endless kill totals are separate from the boss-charge counter. */
export function bossWaveLimit(endlessKills) {
  return endlessKills >= bossSpawnSettings.thirdBossUnlockKills
    ? bossSpawnSettings.unlockedWaveSize : bossSpawnSettings.waveSize;
}

/** Pick distinct bosses only; missing future roster entries never become duplicates. */
export function selectBossWave(stage, endless, endlessKills, roster, random = Math.random) {
  const available = [...new Set(roster)];
  if (!endless) {
    const preferred = bossTypeForStage(stage, random);
    return available.includes(preferred) ? [preferred] : available.slice(0, 1);
  }
  for (let i = available.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    const j = Math.floor(random() * (i + 1));
    [available[i], available[j]] = [available[j], available[i]];
  }
  return available.slice(0, bossWaveLimit(endlessKills));
}

/** Stage 1 always uses Shiroko; unassigned stages retain the current test roster. */
export function bossTypeForStage(stage, random = Math.random) {
  return stage.id === 'first' ? 'shiroko' : random() < 0.5 ? 'iroha' : 'shiroko';
}

/** Chance per eligible kill; switch to the shorter pity curve at 5 minutes after Stage 4. */
export function bossChance(kills, endlessSeconds = null) {
  return bossChanceFormula(kills, endlessSeconds);
}

/** Keep progression separate from total run kills and freeze it while bosses live. */
export function createBossCharge(random = Math.random, getEndlessSeconds = () => null) {
  let kills = 0, pending = false;
  return {
    recordDefeat(bossWasAlive) {
      if (bossWasAlive || pending) return;
      kills++;
      const chance = bossChance(kills, getEndlessSeconds());
      if (chance > 0 && (chance >= 1 || random() < chance)) pending = true;
    },
    // Reaching 5 endless minutes can make the existing kill count immediately guaranteed.
    refresh(bossAlive = false) {
      if (!bossAlive && kills >= bossPityThresholds(getEndlessSeconds()).guaranteedKills) pending = true;
    },
    get thresholds() { return bossPityThresholds(getEndlessSeconds()); },
    reset() { kills = 0; pending = false; },
    get kills() { return kills; },
    get pending() { return pending; },
    get chance() { return bossChance(kills, getEndlessSeconds()); }
  };
}

/** Spawn an offscreen chasing boss after a successful kill roll, retrying blocked spots. */
export function createBossSpawner({ canvas, camera, getStage, spawnBoss, slotsRemaining, onSpawn, isEndless,
  getBossTypes = () => ['shiroko', 'iroha'], getEndlessSeconds = () => null, canSpawnWave = () => true }) {
  const charge = createBossCharge(Math.random, getEndlessSeconds);
  const status = document.querySelector('#boss-spawn-status');
  const details = document.querySelector('#boss-spawn-details');
  let retry = 0;
  let endlessKills = 0;
  let waveQueue = [];

  function updateStatus() {
    const alive = getAllEnemies().filter(isBossEnemy).length;
    const state = alive ? `Frozen: ${alive} boss alive.` : waveQueue.length || charge.pending ? 'Boss wave ready.'
      : `${(charge.chance * 100).toFixed(2)}% chance per kill.`;
    const text = `Boss charge: ${charge.kills}/${charge.thresholds.guaranteedKills}\n${state}\n${isEndless() ? `Endless kills: ${endlessKills}` : 'Stages 1â€“4'}`;
    if (status.textContent !== text) status.textContent = text;
    if (details) details.textContent = `Boss wave: ${isEndless() ? Math.min(bossWaveLimit(endlessKills), new Set(getBossTypes()).size) : 1}. Unlocked slots: ${isEndless() ? bossWaveLimit(endlessKills) : 1}. Pity starts: ${charge.thresholds.pityStart} kills. Unique boss types: ${new Set(getBossTypes()).size}. Waiting to place: ${waveQueue.length}.`;
  }
  const stopSpawn = onEnemySpawn(enemy => {
    if (isBossEnemy(enemy)) {
      charge.reset();
      waveQueue = waveQueue.filter(type => type !== enemy.type);
      updateStatus();
    }
  });
  const stopDefeat = onEnemyDefeat(({ bossesAliveBefore }) => {
    if (isEndless()) endlessKills++;
    charge.recordDefeat(bossesAliveBefore > 0 || waveQueue.length > 0);
    updateStatus();
  });

  /** Keep guaranteed spawns pending until a valid offscreen spot and slot exist. */
  function update(delta) {
    charge.refresh(getAllEnemies().some(isBossEnemy) || waveQueue.length > 0);
    updateStatus();
    retry = Math.max(0, retry - delta);
    if (retry > 0 || slotsRemaining() <= 0) return;
    if (!waveQueue.length) {
      if (!canSpawnWave()) return;
      if (!charge.pending || getAllEnemies().some(isBossEnemy)) return;
      waveQueue = selectBossWave(getStage(), isEndless(), endlessKills, getBossTypes());
    }
    if (!waveQueue.length) return;
    retry = bossSpawnSettings.retryInterval;
    const stage = { ...getStage(), spawnMargin: 150, spawnRadius: bossSpriteSize / 2 };
    let spawned = false;
    for (const type of [...waveQueue]) {
      if (slotsRemaining() <= 0) break;
      if (getAllEnemies().some(enemy => isBossEnemy(enemy) && enemy.type === type)) {
        waveQueue = waveQueue.filter(entry => entry !== type);
        continue;
      }
      for (let attempt = 0; attempt < bossSpawnSettings.placementAttempts; attempt++) {
        const point = offscreenSpawnPoint(stage, camera, canvas.width, canvas.height);
        if (point && spawnBoss(type, point.x, point.y)) {
          waveQueue = waveQueue.filter(entry => entry !== type);
          charge.reset();
          spawned = true;
          break;
        }
      }
    }
    if (spawned) onSpawn();
    updateStatus();
  }
  updateStatus();
  return { update,
    requestWave() {
      if (getAllEnemies().some(isBossEnemy) || waveQueue.length) return false;
      waveQueue = selectBossWave(getStage(), isEndless(), endlessKills, getBossTypes());
      charge.reset();
      retry = 0;
      return waveQueue.length > 0;
    },
    get hasPendingWave() { return waveQueue.length > 0; },
    get endlessKills() { return endlessKills; }, dispose() { stopSpawn(); stopDefeat(); } };
}

/** Split a level-scaled boss reward into positive reports without losing EXP. */
export function rollBossReports(player, random = Math.random) {

  const count = Math.max(bossExpRewards.minimumReports, Math.ceil(total / reportSettings.thirdMax));

/** Let the drawing identify a ready EX skill; autoattacks never require weapon selection. */
export async function recognizeLoadoutPattern(strokes, skills, recognizer, isCurrent = () => true) {
  let failure = { valid: false, reason: 'No ready skill matches this pattern.' };
  for (const weapon of skills) {
    if (weapon.skillCooldownRemaining > 0) continue;
    if (!isCurrent()) return { valid: false, cancelled: true };
    const result = await recognizeWeaponPattern(strokes, weapon, recognizer, isCurrent);
    if (result.valid) return { ...result, weapon };
    if (weapon.id === 'plana-umbrella') failure = result;
  }
  return failure;
}


/** Crown below an inverted bullet, flanked by two lines; matching ignores scale/order. */
export function supernovaReferenceStrokes() {
  const path = points => points.map(([x,y]) => ({x,y}));
  return [path([[45,165],[35,115],[62,142],[70,110],[86,140],[100,105],[114,140],[130,110],[138,142],[165,115],[155,165],[45,165]]),
    path([[78,25],[122,25],[122,65],[100,96],[78,65],[78,25]]),
    path([[10,35],[10,155]]), path([[190,35],[190,155]])];
}

/** Geometric whole-symbol matching plus isolated QuickDraw assistance, with offline fallback. */
export async function recognizeSupernovaPattern(strokes, recognizer, isCurrent) {
  const normalized = normalizeSkillStrokes(strokes);
  const bounds = drawingBounds(normalized);
  if (!bounds) return {valid:false,reason:'Draw the Supernova pattern.'};
  const width = bounds.right-bounds.left, height = bounds.bottom-bounds.top;
  const hasSide = right => normalized.some(stroke => {
    const part = drawingBounds([stroke]);

    if (!isCurrent()) return {valid:false,cancelled:true};
    try { components.push({name:'Supernova component',predictions:await recognizer.recognize(drawingModelImage([stroke]))}); }

  }
  return {valid:true,skillId:'supernova-beam',label:'Supernova',score:accuracy,accuracy,

VERBATIM AGGREGATED_OUTPUT:
import { segmentPlanaPattern } from './plana-pattern.js';
import { drawingModelImage, drawingBounds, normalizeSkillStrokes } from './skill-drawing.js';
import { drawingAccuracy, skillDamageMultiplier } from './skill-accuracy.js';
import { skillCastSettings } from './game-config.js';

/** Require interior ink in both symbol regions before allowing CLIP to rescue rough geometry. */
function hasBothSymbols(strokes) {
  const b = drawingBounds(strokes);
  if (!b) return false;
  const cx = (b.left + b.right) / 2, cy = (b.top + b.bottom) / 2;
  const w = b.right - b.left, h = b.bottom - b.top;
  if (!(w > 0) || !(h > 0)) return false;
  const inner = strokes.flat().filter(p => Math.hypot((p.x-cx)/(w/2), (p.y-cy)/(h/2)) < .76);
  return inner.some(p => p.y < cy && p.x < cx-w*.04) &&
    inner.some(p => p.y < cy && p.x > cx+w*.04) &&
    inner.some(p => p.y > cy && p.x < cx-w*.04) &&
    inner.some(p => p.y > cy && p.x > cx+w*.04);
}

/** Combine full-symbol CLIP, isolated QuickDraw parts and forgiving spatial validation. */
export async function recognizeWeaponPattern(strokes, weapon, recognizer, isCurrent = () => true) {
  if (weapon?.id === 'aris-laser') return recognizeSupernovaPattern(strokes, recognizer, isCurrent);
  if (weapon?.id !== 'plana-umbrella') return { valid: false, reason: 'No drawing skill is defined for this weapon yet.' };
  if (!isCurrent()) return { valid: false, cancelled: true };
  strokes = normalizeSkillStrokes(strokes);
  const pattern = segmentPlanaPattern(strokes);
  const accuracy = drawingAccuracy(strokes);
  let clipPredictions = [], clipError;
  try {
    if (recognizer.recognizeSymbol) clipPredictions = await recognizer.recognizeSymbol(drawingModelImage(strokes));
  } catch (error) {
    // Download/inference failure must not disable an otherwise recognized geometric cast.
    clipError = error.message;
  }
  if (!isCurrent()) return { valid: false, cancelled: true };
  const clipMatch = clipPredictions[0]?.label === 'a hand drawn circle enclosing an arrow above an X cross' &&
    clipPredictions[0].score >= skillCastSettings.clipMinimumScore;
  const rescued = clipMatch && accuracy >= skillCastSettings.referenceMinimum && hasBothSymbols(strokes);
  if (!pattern.valid && !rescued) return { ...pattern, clipPredictions, accuracy };
  const components = [];
  // When geometry cannot reliably split rough ink, ask QuickDraw about the whole sketch.
  const parts = pattern.valid ? pattern.parts : [{ name: 'whole pattern', strokes }];
  for (const part of parts) {
    if (!isCurrent()) return { valid: false, cancelled: true };
    try {
      const predictions = await recognizer.recognize(drawingModelImage(part.strokes));
      components.push({ name: part.name, predictions });
    } catch (error) {
      components.push({ name: part.name, predictions: [], error: error.message });
    }
  }
  if (!isCurrent()) return { valid: false, cancelled: true };
  return { valid: true, skillId: 'plana-umbrella-launch', label: 'Plana: Umbrella Launch',
    score: pattern.valid ? pattern.score : clipPredictions[0].score,
    accuracy, damageMultiplier: skillDamageMultiplier(accuracy), components, clipPredictions, clipError };
}


/** Let the drawing identify a ready EX skill; autoattacks never require weapon selection. */
export async function recognizeLoadoutPattern(strokes, skills, recognizer, isCurrent = () => true) {
  let failure = { valid: false, reason: 'No ready skill matches this pattern.' };
  for (const weapon of skills) {
    if (weapon.skillCooldownRemaining > 0) continue;
    if (!isCurrent()) return { valid: false, cancelled: true };
    const result = await recognizeWeaponPattern(strokes, weapon, recognizer, isCurrent);
    if (result.valid) return { ...result, weapon };
    if (weapon.id === 'plana-umbrella') failure = result;
  }
  return failure;
}


/** Accept3,4or5crown spikes; no flanking lines. Stroke order/scale remain irrelevant. */
export function supernovaReferenceStrokes(spikes = 5) {
  const path = points => points.map(([x,y]) => ({x,y}));
  const count = Math.max(3, Math.min(5, Math.round(spikes)));
  const crown = [[45,165]];
  for (let i=0; i<count; i++) {
    const x=35+i*130/(count-1);
    crown.push([x,110]);
    if (i<count-1) crown.push([x+65/(count-1),142]);
  }
  crown.push([155,165],[45,165]);
  return [path(crown),path([[78,25],[122,25],[122,65],[100,96],[78,65],[78,25]])];
}

/** Geometric whole-symbol matching plus isolated QuickDraw assistance, with offline fallback. */
export async function recognizeSupernovaPattern(strokes, recognizer, isCurrent) {
  const normalized = normalizeSkillStrokes(strokes);
  const bounds = drawingBounds(normalized);
  if (!bounds) return {valid:false,reason:'Draw the Supernova pattern.'};
  const width = bounds.right-bounds.left, height = bounds.bottom-bounds.top;
  const split = bounds.top + height*.53;
  const upper = normalized.map(stroke=>stroke.filter(p=>p.y<split)).filter(s=>s.length);
  const lower = normalized.map(stroke=>stroke.filter(p=>p.y>=split)).filter(s=>s.length);
  const bulletBounds=drawingBounds(upper), crownBounds=drawingBounds(lower);
  // The narrow bullet sits above the wider crown; reject enclosing circles/partial symbols.
  if (!bulletBounds || !crownBounds || bulletBounds.right-bulletBounds.left>width*.75 ||
      crownBounds.right-crownBounds.left<width*.75 || bulletBounds.bottom-bulletBounds.top<height*.25) {
    return {valid:false,reason:'Draw an inverted bullet above a crown with3?5spikes.'};
  }
  const accuracy = Math.max(...[3,4,5].map(count=>drawingAccuracy(strokes,supernovaReferenceStrokes(count))));
  if (accuracy < .62) return {valid:false, reason:'Draw a crown with3?5spikes and an inverted bullet.'};
  const components = [];
  for (const stroke of normalizeSkillStrokes(strokes)) {
    if (!isCurrent()) return {valid:false,cancelled:true};
    try { components.push({name:'Supernova component',predictions:await recognizer.recognize(drawingModelImage([stroke]))}); }
    catch { /* Local reference remains available when model inference is offline. */ }
  }
  return {valid:true,skillId:'supernova-beam',label:'Supernova',score:accuracy,accuracy,
    damageMultiplier:skillDamageMultiplier(accuracy),components};
}

/** Symmetric ink distance rewards the entire reference, including missing/extra marks. */
export function drawingAccuracy(strokes, referenceStrokes = planaReferenceStrokes()) {
  const actual = normalizedInk(strokes), reference = normalizedInk(referenceStrokes);
  if (!actual.length) return 0;
  const nearestMean = (from, to) => from.reduce((total, p) => total +
    Math.min(...to.map(q => Math.hypot(p.x - q.x, p.y - q.y))), 0) / from.length;
  const error = (nearestMean(actual, reference) + nearestMean(reference, actual)) / 2;
  return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, 1 - error / skillCastSettings.accuracyDistanceTolerance));
}

function simplify(points, tolerance) {
  if (points.length <= 2) return points;

import { combatBalance } from './game-config.js';
import { normalSpriteSize, spriteDisplayPadding } from './scene-metrics.js';

// EDIT half-width, half-height and center offset as fractions of display size.
// Ellipses exclude transparent corners while covering more of the visible body.
export const combatHitboxes = {
  plana: { rx: 0.27, ry: 0.38, y: 0.03, playerOffsetY: 6, playerRadiusScale: 0.72 }, // Pixels downward for the controlled player.
  arona: { rx: 0.25, ry: 0.39, y: 0.03 },
  // Small foot-level ellipse: tune rx/ry for size; feet keeps it at the sprite baseline.
  midori: { rx: 0.13, ry: 0.075, radiusSize: normalSpriteSize, feet: true },
  yuuka: { rx: 0.25, ry: 0.42, y: 0.02 },
  mob: { rx: 0.28, ry: 0.28, y: 0.04, eliteOffsetY: 6, normalOffsetY: 6 }, // Circular Mob collider; elite variants scale the same profile.
  iroha: { rx: 0.44, ry: 0.29, y: 0.06 },
  shiroko: { rx: 0.30, ry: 0.30, y: 0.05 } // Center on the visible body below the halo.
};

/** Return a stable body ellipse, scaling automatically for elite/boss sizes. */
export function getCombatHitbox(character, enemy = Boolean(character.id)) {
  const name = (character.type || character.label || 'mob').toLowerCase();
  const key = Object.keys(combatHitboxes).find(type => name.includes(type)) || 'mob';
  const profile = character.combatHitbox || combatHitboxes[key];
  const size = character.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize;
  const hitboxScale = enemy ? combatBalance.enemyHitboxScale : 1;
  const radiusSize = profile.radiusSize || size;
  const rx = radiusSize * profile.rx * hitboxScale * (enemy ? 1 : profile.playerRadiusScale || 1);
  // Compress player height to the existing half-width, producing a centered circle.
  const ry = enemy ? radiusSize * profile.ry * hitboxScale : rx;
  // Foot-anchored profiles retain their small dimensions when the artwork grows.
  const offsetY = !enemy ? (profile.playerOffsetY || 0) : profile.feet ? size / 2 - spriteDisplayPadding - ry : size * profile.y;
  const eliteOffsetY = enemy ? (character.elite ? profile.eliteOffsetY || 0 : profile.normalOffsetY || 0) : 0;
  return { x: character.x, y: character.y + offsetY + eliteOffsetY, rx, ry };
}

/** Test a blade segment against an ellipse in normalized body coordinates. */
export function segmentHitsBody(body, x1, y1, x2, y2) {
  const x = (x1 - body.x) / body.rx, y = (y1 - body.y) / body.ry;
  const dx = (x2 - x1) / body.rx, dy = (y2 - y1) / body.ry;
  const length = dx * dx + dy * dy;
  const t = length ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1, -(x * dx + y * dy) / length)) : 0;
  return (x + dx * t) ** 2 + (y + dy * t) ** 2 <= 1;
}

  /** Use a tapered arc and fading prior poses to convey speed without flashing. */
  function draw(outputContext, camera) {
    if (!swing || !image.naturalWidth) return;
    const context = trailContext;
    context.clearRect(0, 0, trailCanvas.width, trailCanvas.height);
    context.save();
    context.translate(trailCenter, trailCenter);
    const angle = umbrellaSwingAngle(swing.aim, swing.elapsed, swing.duration);
    const visualTime = Math.min(swing.elapsed, swing.duration);
    const fade = (1 - Math.max(0, (swing.elapsed - swing.duration) / swing.linger)) ** 1.5;
    context.lineCap = 'round';
    // Continuous cyan sweep fills the entire travelled arc, including its endpoints.
    context.beginPath();
    context.arc(0, 0, umbrellaSettings.reach * .84, umbrellaSwingAngle(swing.aim, 0), angle);
    context.strokeStyle = `rgba(75, 210, 255, ${.42 * fade})`;
    context.lineWidth = 22;
    context.stroke();
    for (let i = 5; i >= 1; i--) {
      const earlier = Math.max(0, visualTime - i * 0.026 / swing.haste);
      const previous = umbrellaSwingAngle(swing.aim, earlier, swing.duration);
      context.beginPath();
      const trailRadius = umbrellaSettings.baseRadius +
        (umbrellaSettings.reach - umbrellaSettings.baseRadius) * (0.76 + i * 0.035);
      context.arc(0, 0, trailRadius, previous, angle);
      context.strokeStyle = `rgba(244, 169, 255, ${0.12 * fade})`;
      context.lineWidth = 4 + (6 - i) * 2;
      context.stroke();
    }
    // Sample by ANGLE, not time: fast parts of the swing need more overlapping
    // poses, otherwise evenly timed ghosts separate into individual umbrellas.
    const trailStart = umbrellaSwingAngle(swing.aim,
      Math.max(0, visualTime - umbrellaSettings.trailDuration / swing.haste), swing.duration);
    const span = angle - trailStart;
    const samples = Math.min(umbrellaSettings.maxAfterimages,
      Math.ceil(span / umbrellaSettings.trailAngleStep));
    for (let i = 0; i < samples; i++) {
      const weight = i / samples;
      drawBlade(context, trailStart + span * weight,
        (0.018 + 0.032 * weight * weight) * fade);
    }
    context.restore();
    outputContext.save();
    outputContext.translate(owner.x - camera.x, owner.y - camera.y);
    outputContext.scale(swing.areaScale, swing.areaScale);
    outputContext.filter = `blur(${umbrellaSettings.trailBlur}px)`;
    outputContext.drawImage(trailCanvas, -trailCenter, -trailCenter);
    outputContext.filter = 'none';
    // The actual umbrella ends on time; only its soft trail lingers afterward.
    if (swing.elapsed < swing.duration) drawBlade(outputContext, angle, 1);
    outputContext.restore();
  }

  /** Clear a pending swing when the scene is reset. */
  function reset() { owner = null; swing = null; cycle = 0; clock = 0; hitTimes.clear(); }
  return { ready, update, draw, reset };
}

/** Paint the full travelled blue sector with rounded ends, independent of blur/trail age. */
export function drawUmbrellaSweep(context, start, end, fade) {
  if (end <= start || fade <= 0) return;
  const outer = umbrellaSettings.reach;
  const inner = umbrellaSettings.baseRadius + 12;
  context.save();
  context.beginPath();
  context.arc(0,0,outer,start,end);
  context.lineTo(Math.cos(end)*inner,Math.sin(end)*inner);
  context.arc(0,0,inner,end,start,true);
  context.closePath();
  context.fillStyle = `rgba(52,193,255,${.17*fade})`;
  context.fill();
  context.beginPath();
  context.arc(0,0,outer*.84,start,end);
  context.strokeStyle = `rgba(110,232,255,${.6*fade})`;
  context.lineWidth = 5;
  context.lineCap = 'round';
  context.stroke();
  context.restore();
}

import { skillCastSettings } from './game-config.js';

/** List equipped weapon skills and an optional future ultimate, each with its own timer. */
export function equippedSkills(character) {
  return [...(character.attackSlots || []), character.ultimateSkill].filter(skill => skill?.icon && skill.exSkill !== false);
}

/** Find availability only; this does not select or equip a weapon. */
export function readySkill(character) {
  return equippedSkills(character).find(skill => !(skill.skillCooldownRemaining > 0));
}

/** Put a cooldown on the exact weapon that initiated a cast, independently of other weapons. */
export function setSkillCooldown(weapon, seconds) {
  weapon.skillCooldownDuration = seconds;
  weapon.skillCooldownRemaining = seconds;
}

/** Tick each equipped weapon once; global pause freezes these timers in the game loop. */
export function advanceSkillCooldowns(characters, delta) {
  const visited = new Set();
  for (const character of characters) for (const weapon of equippedSkills(character)) {
    if (!weapon || visited.has(weapon)) continue;
    visited.add(weapon);
    weapon.skillCooldownRemaining = Math.max(0, (weapon.skillCooldownRemaining || 0) - Math.max(0, delta));
  }
}

/** Drawing-cast state machine; async recognition responses must match the current token. */
export function createSkillCastState(onSubmit = () => {}) {
  let phase = 'idle', owner = null, weapon = null;
  let elapsed = 0, idle = 0, drawing = false, inkLength = 0, token = 0;
  return {
    get phase() { return phase; }, get owner() { return owner; }, get weapon() { return weapon; },
    get token() { return token; }, get inkLength() { return inkLength; },
    get remaining() { return Math.max(0, skillCastSettings.drawingSeconds - elapsed); },
    begin(character, item, adminTest = false) {
      if (phase !== 'idle' || !item?.icon || (!adminTest && item.skillCooldownRemaining > 0)) return false;
      owner = character; weapon = item; elapsed = idle = inkLength = 0; drawing = false;
      phase = 'drawing'; token++;
      return true;
    },
    strokeStart() { if (phase === 'drawing') { drawing = true; idle = 0; } },
    addInk(length) { if (phase === 'drawing') { inkLength += Math.max(0, length); idle = 0; } },
    strokeEnd() { drawing = false; idle = 0; },
    update(delta) {
      if (phase !== 'drawing') return;
      const time = Math.max(0, delta);
      elapsed += time;
      if (!drawing && inkLength > 0) idle += time;
      if (elapsed >= skillCastSettings.drawingSeconds || idle >= skillCastSettings.idleSubmitSeconds) {
        if (inkLength <= skillCastSettings.minimumInkLength) { this.cancel('empty'); return; }
        phase = 'recognizing'; drawing = false;
        onSubmit({ token, owner, weapon });
      }
    },
    cancel(reason) {
      if (phase === 'idle') return false;
      const penalty = reason === 'pause' ? skillCastSettings.pauseCancelCooldown
        : reason === 'right' ? skillCastSettings.rightCancelCooldown
        : reason === 'empty' ? skillCastSettings.failureCooldown : 0;
      if (penalty) setSkillCooldown(weapon, penalty);
      token++; phase = 'idle'; drawing = false;
      return true;
    },
    resolve(requestToken, result) {
      if (requestToken !== token || phase !== 'recognizing') return false;
      const valid = result && typeof result.label === 'string' && result.label.length > 0 &&
        Number.isFinite(result.score) && result.score >= skillCastSettings.minimumConfidence;
      if (result?.weapon) {
        if (!equippedSkills(owner).includes(result.weapon) || (!result.adminTest && result.weapon.skillCooldownRemaining > 0)) return false;
        weapon = result.weapon;
      }
      // Every completed attempt starts its cooldown, including failed recognition.
      setSkillCooldown(weapon, valid ? skillCastSettings.successCooldown : skillCastSettings.failureCooldown);
      if (valid) {
        weapon.lastSkillDrawing = { label: result.label, score: result.score, skillId: result.skillId, components: result.components,
          accuracy: result.accuracy, damageMultiplier: result.damageMultiplier, clipPredictions: result.clipPredictions };
      }
      phase = 'idle'; token++;
      return Boolean(valid);
    }
  };
}
    activeStroke = null; pointerId = null;
  }

  /** Cancel drawing or pending recognition; failed empty attempts and explicit right-click/pause incur cooldowns. */
  function cancel(reason) {
    if (!state.cancel(reason)) return;
    closeOverlay();
    setStatus(reason === 'pause' ? 'Cast cancelled: 1:00 cooldown.'
      : reason === 'right' ? 'Cast cancelled: 0:30 cooldown.'
      : reason === 'empty' ? 'No drawing submitted. Skill cooldown started.' : 'Cast cancelled.');
  }

  function toggleCast(event) {
    if (event.button !== 2) return;
    event.preventDefault(); event.stopPropagation();
    if (isPaused()) return;
    if (state.phase !== 'idle') { cancel('right'); return; }

/** Choose a cancellation target locally; empty/unrelated ink never selects a default slot. */
export function closestDrawingSkill(strokes, skills) {
  if (!drawingBounds(strokes)) return null;
  let best = null, score = .25;
  for (const weapon of skills) {
    if (weapon.skillCooldownRemaining > 0) continue;
    const reference = weapon.id === 'aris-laser' ? supernovaReferenceStrokes() : undefined;
    if (!reference && weapon.id !== 'plana-umbrella') continue;
    const accuracy = drawingAccuracy(strokes, reference);
    if (accuracy > score) { score = accuracy; best = weapon; }
  }
  return best;
}

import { umbrellaSettings, attackTimeFormula } from './game-config.js';
export { umbrellaSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { getAllEnemies, damageEnemy } from './world-state.js';
import { getCombatHitbox, segmentHitsBody } from './combat-hitboxes.js';
import { umbrellaLevelStats, rollUmbrellaDamage } from './weapon-progression.js';
import { statMultiplier, ensureCombatStats } from './combat-stats.js';

// EDIT attack balance and timing here. Interval is measured start to start:
// 1.5 seconds total = 0.2 seconds swinging + 1.3 seconds before the next swing.
const crop = { x: 100, y: 228, width: 68, height: 304 };

/** Ease into a swift central slash, then decelerate at the end of a 180ÃƒÆ’Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â° sweep. */
export function umbrellaSwingAngle(aim, elapsed, duration = umbrellaSettings.duration) {
  const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, elapsed / duration));
  const eased = t < 0.5 ? 4 * t ** 3 : 1 - (-2 * t + 2) ** 3 / 2;
  const arc = umbrellaSettings.arcDegrees * Math.PI / 180;
  return aim - arc / 2 + eased * arc;
}

/** Test the swept blade sector so fast swings cannot skip enemies between frames. */
export function umbrellaHits(player, enemy, fromAngle, toAngle, areaScale = 1) {
  const body = getCombatHitbox(enemy, true);
  const dx = body.x - player.x, dy = body.y - player.y;
  const distance = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
  const radius = Math.max(body.rx, body.ry);
  if (distance > umbrellaSettings.reach * areaScale + radius) return false;
  if (distance + radius < umbrellaSettings.baseRadius * areaScale) return false;
  // Subdivide the swept sector into blade segments at most 2 degrees apart.
  const samples = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(Math.abs(toAngle - fromAngle) / (Math.PI / 90)));
  for (let i = 0; i <= samples; i++) {
    const angle = fromAngle + (toAngle - fromAngle) * i / samples;
    const x = Math.cos(angle), y = Math.sin(angle);
    if (segmentHitsBody(body,
      player.x + x * umbrellaSettings.baseRadius * areaScale, player.y + y * umbrellaSettings.baseRadius * areaScale,
      player.x + x * umbrellaSettings.reach * areaScale, player.y + y * umbrellaSettings.reach * areaScale)) return true;
  }
  return false;
}


/** Unlimited piercing capsule; every enemy still observes its own hit cooldown. */
export function arisBeamHits(enemy, origin, angle, width, length = arisWeaponSettings.beamLength) {
  const body = getCombatHitbox(enemy, true);
  return segmentHitsBody({ ...body, rx: body.rx + width / 2, ry: body.ry + width / 2 },
    origin.x + Math.cos(angle) * arisBeamOffset(origin,angle), origin.y + Math.sin(angle) * arisBeamOffset(origin,angle), origin.x + Math.cos(angle) * length, origin.y + Math.sin(angle) * length);
}

import { enemyTypeStats, eliteSizeMultiplier } from './game-config.js';
import { combatHitboxes } from './combat-hitboxes.js';
import { normalSpriteSize } from './scene-metrics.js';

/** Mega Mob shares Mob's animation and body geometry, enlarged for mini-boss visibility. */
export function createMegaMob(template) {
  return {...template,label:'Mega Mob',miniBoss:true,boss:false,standard:false,special:true,
    spriteSize:(template.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize)*eliteSizeMultiplier,
    combatHitbox:combatHitboxes.mob};
}

/** Retry blocked/full-population placements; consume the one-shot only on success. */
export function createMiniBossSchedule() {
  const spawned = new Set();
  return { update(seconds, spawn) {
    for (const [type, profile] of Object.entries(enemyTypeStats)) {
      if (type !== 'megaMob' || profile.spawnAtSeconds == null || seconds < profile.spawnAtSeconds || spawned.has(type)) continue;
      if (spawn(type)) spawned.add(type);
    }
  }};
}
/** Roll basic-enemy elites; bosses and playable-character test NPCs are excluded. */
export function enemyVariant(type, template, mode = 'random', random = Math.random, survivalSeconds = 0, endlessSeconds = null, eliteProbability = eliteChanceFormula(endlessSeconds)) {
  const elite = template.miniBoss === true || type === 'midori' || (type === 'mob' || template.standard) && (mode === 'elite' || (mode === 'random' && random() < eliteProbability));
  const baseHp = (['mob', 'midori'].includes(type) || template.standard) ? basicMobHpFormula(survivalSeconds)
    : type === 'shiroko' ? mobBaseHp * shirokoBossStats.hpMultiplier : combatBalance.otherEnemyHp;
  const dedicatedMega = type === 'megaMob' || (type === 'mob' && elite);
  const profile = enemyTypeStats[dedicatedMega ? 'megaMob' : type];
  const scaled = profile ? enemyStatsScalingFormula(profile, campaignScalingTimeFormula(endlessSeconds)) : null;
  const maxHp = (scaled?.hp ?? baseHp) * (elite && !dedicatedMega ? combatBalance.eliteHpMultiplier : 1);
  return {
    elite,
    miniBoss: template.miniBoss === true || (elite && type !== 'midori'),
    label: dedicatedMega ? 'Mega Mob' : elite && type !== 'midori' ? `Mega ${template.label}` : template.label,
    spriteSize: (template.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) * (elite && type !== 'midori' && !template.miniBoss ? eliteSizeMultiplier : 1),
    hp: maxHp,
    maxHp,
    contactDamage: type === 'shiroko' ? shirokoBossStats.contactDamage : template.contactDamage,
    contactDamageMultiplier: elite && !dedicatedMega ? 2 : 1,
    ...(profile ? { hp: Math.round(maxHp), maxHp: Math.round(maxHp), perTypeStats: true,
      contactDamage: scaled.atk, expReward: profile.expValue,
      movementSpeedMultiplier: scaled.spd * playerSettings.speed / playerSettings.movementBase } : {})
  };
}

import { timedEnemyEvents } from './game-config.js';

/** Compact square-grid cluster; offsets are deterministic and centered on its anchor. */
export function clusterSpawnPoints(anchor, count, spacing) {
  const columns=Math.ceil(Math.sqrt(count)), rows=Math.ceil(count/columns);
  return Array.from({length:count},(_,i)=>({
    x:anchor.x+(i%columns-(columns-1)/2)*spacing,
    y:anchor.y+(Math.floor(i/columns)-(rows-1)/2)*spacing
  }));
}

/** Place each scheduled formation once; retry invalid anchors/full capacity without duplicates. */
export function createTimedEnemyEvents(getPoints, spawn, events = timedEnemyEvents) {
  const pending = new Map();
  return { update(seconds) {
    for (const event of events) {
      if (seconds<event.timeSeconds) continue;
      let state=pending.get(event.id);
      if (!state) { state={index:0,points:null};pending.set(event.id,state); }
      if (state.index>=event.count) continue;
      state.points ??= getPoints(event);
      if (!state.points) continue;
      while (state.index<event.count) {
        if (!spawn(event,state.points[state.index])) break;
        state.index++;
      }
    }
  }};
}

/** Return enemies near the viewport for future rendering; retain all other records. */
export function getVisibleEnemies(cameraX, viewportWidth, margin = 160) {
  return [...enemies.values()].filter(enemy =>
    enemy.x >= cameraX - margin &&
    enemy.x <= cameraX + viewportWidth + margin
  );
}

import { timedEnemyEvents } from './game-config.js';

/** Compact square-grid cluster; offsets are deterministic and centered on its anchor. */
export function clusterSpawnPoints(anchor, count, spacing) {
  const columns=Math.ceil(Math.sqrt(count)), rows=Math.ceil(count/columns);
  return Array.from({length:count},(_,i)=>({
    x:anchor.x+(i%columns-(columns-1)/2)*spacing,
    y:anchor.y+(Math.floor(i/columns)-(rows-1)/2)*spacing
  }));
}

/** Place each scheduled formation once; retry invalid anchors/full capacity without duplicates. */
export function createTimedEnemyEvents(getPoints, spawn, events = timedEnemyEvents) {
  const pending = new Map();
  return { update(seconds) {
    for (const event of events) {
      if (seconds<event.timeSeconds) continue;
      let state=pending.get(event.id);
      if (!state) { state={index:0,points:null};pending.set(event.id,state); }
      if (event.lifetimeSeconds != null && seconds >= event.timeSeconds+event.lifetimeSeconds) {
        state.index=event.count; continue;
      }
      if (state.index>=event.count) continue;
      state.points ??= getPoints(event);
      if (!state.points) continue;
      while (state.index<event.count) {
        if (!spawn(event,state.points[state.index])) break;
        state.index++;
      }
    }
  }};
}


/** Lock a horde's course at spawn; it never homes toward later player positions. */
export function hordeMotion(enemy) {
  const angle = enemy.chargeAngle ?? 0;
  const directions=['right','downRight','down','downLeft','left','upLeft','up','upRight'];
  return {direction:directions[(Math.round(angle/(Math.PI/4))+8)%8],
    target:{x:enemy.x+Math.cos(angle)*10000,y:enemy.y+Math.sin(angle)*10000}};
}


/** Two opposite straight walls; split odd counts without losing enemies. */
export function wallSpawnPoints(bounds, count, vertical = true) {
  const first=Math.ceil(count/2), second=count-first;
  return [first,second].flatMap((amount,side)=>Array.from({length:amount},(_,i)=>{
    const t=amount>1?i/(amount-1):.5;
    return vertical?{x:side?bounds.right:bounds.left,y:bounds.top+t*(bounds.bottom-bounds.top)}:
      {x:bounds.left+t*(bounds.right-bounds.left),y:side?bounds.bottom:bounds.top};
  }));
}

/** Only numeric overrides replace the enemy defaults; unspecified stats remain intact. */
export function timedEventStatOverrides(event) {
  const stats=event?.stats;
  if (!stats || typeof stats!=='object') return {};
  return {...(Number.isFinite(stats.hp)?{hp:stats.hp,maxHp:stats.hp}:{}),
    ...(Number.isFinite(stats.atk)?{contactDamage:stats.atk}:{}),
    ...(Number.isFinite(stats.exp)?{expReward:stats.exp}:{})};
}


/** Evenly spaced complete circle around the player's position at formation creation. */
export function ringSpawnPoints(center, count, radius) {
  return Array.from({length:count},(_,i)=>{
    const angle=i/count*Math.PI*2;
    return {x:center.x+Math.cos(angle)*radius,y:center.y+Math.sin(angle)*radius};
  });
}

import { createEndlessBuildup } from './endless-buildup.js';
import { endlessEventSettings, eliteChance, midoriSettings } from './game-config.js';

export const endlessEventRegistry = {
  eliteSurge: { name: 'Elite Surge', create: onComplete => createEndlessBuildup(onComplete) },
  midori: { name: 'Midori Invasion' }
};

/** Manage elite surges and their boss-or-Midori outcome; admin triggers bypass campaign timing. */
export function createEndlessEvents(onBossReady, random = Math.random, onMidoriStart = () => {}, onEventEnd = () => {}) {
  let event = null, definition = null, bossWasAlive = false;
  let midoriRemaining = 0, manual = false;
  let eventKey = null, eventSequence = 0;
  function endCurrent() {
    if (eventKey) onEventEnd(eventKey);
    eventKey = null;
  }

  /** Begin a Midori-only stream in place of requesting the boss wave. */
  function startMidori() {
    endCurrent();
    eventKey = `midori-${++eventSequence}`;
    midoriRemaining = midoriSettings.eventSeconds;
    definition = endlessEventRegistry.midori;
    onMidoriStart();
  }
  /** Resolve an elite army before choosing its replacement encounter. */
  function finishElites() {
    endCurrent();
    if (random() < endlessEventSettings.midoriAfterEliteChance) startMidori();
    else onBossReady();
  }
  function chooseEvent() {
    endCurrent();
    midoriRemaining = 0;
    const ids = endlessEventSettings.enabledEvents.filter(id => endlessEventRegistry[id]?.create);
    const id = ids[Math.floor(random() * ids.length)];
    definition = endlessEventRegistry[id] || null;
    event = definition ? definition.create(finishElites) : null;
    eventKey = definition ? `eliteSurge-${++eventSequence}` : null;
  }
  chooseEvent();
  return {
    get name() { return definition?.name || 'None'; },
    get phase() { return midoriRemaining > 0 ? 'midori' : event?.phase || 'normal'; },
    get seconds() { return midoriRemaining > 0 ? midoriSettings.eventSeconds - midoriRemaining : event?.seconds || 0; },
    get active() { return manual || midoriRemaining > 0; },
    get eliteChance() { return midoriRemaining > 0 ? 0 : event?.eliteChance ?? eliteChance; },
    get spawnEventKey() { return midoriRemaining > 0 || ['ramp', 'elites'].includes(event?.phase) ? eventKey : null; },
    get spawnType() { return midoriRemaining > 0 ? 'midori' : null; },
    get allowsBossWave() { return midoriRemaining <= 0 && (!event || event.phase === 'ready'); },
    spawnRate(normalRate) { return midoriRemaining > 0 ? normalRate : event ? event.spawnRate(normalRate) : normalRate; },
    /** Start either event immediately for testing without enabling endless progression. */
    trigger(id) {
      if (!['midori', 'eliteSurge'].includes(id)) return false;
      manual = true;
      if (id === 'midori') startMidori();
      else if (id === 'eliteSurge') {
        endCurrent();
        eventKey = `eliteSurge-${++eventSequence}`;
        midoriRemaining = 0;
        definition = endlessEventRegistry.eliteSurge;
        event = definition.create(finishElites);
        event.startElites();
      } else { manual = false; return false; }
    hud?.update(characters[selected]);
    if (activeCharacter.animationFrames) activeCharacter.gifElapsed = (activeCharacter.gifElapsed || 0) + delta * 1000 * (activeCharacter.animationSpeed || 1);
    if (activeCharacter.transition) activeCharacter.transition.elapsed += delta * 1000;
    const playerBefore = { x: activeCharacter.x, y: activeCharacter.y };
    updateCharacter(activeCharacter, delta, direction);
    const playerMotion = { x: activeCharacter.x - playerBefore.x, y: activeCharacter.y - playerBefore.y };
    updateCamera(delta);
    npcTools?.cleanup(); // Reclaim distant/invalid NPC slots before the next spawn batch.
    endlessBuildup.update(delta, { endless: endlessMode,
      bossAlive: getAllEnemies().some(isBossEnemy), spawning: Boolean(playtestSpawner?.running) });
    const buildupStatus = document.querySelector('#endless-buildup-status');
    if (buildupStatus) buildupStatus.textContent = endlessMode || endlessBuildup.active
      ? `Event: ${endlessBuildup.name} (${endlessBuildup.phase}). Cycle time: ${Math.floor(endlessBuildup.seconds)}s. Elite chance: ${(endlessBuildup.eliteChance * 100).toFixed(1)}%.`
      : 'Endless buildup: available after Stage 4.';
    bossSpawner?.update(delta);
    playtestSpawner?.update(delta, playerMotion);
    npcTools?.update(delta, playerMotion);
    const attackFacing = activeCharacter.horizontalFacingOnly
      ? activeCharacter.facing : activeCharacter.direction;

import { combatHitboxes } from './combat-hitboxes.js';
import { normalSpriteSize, sweeperSettings } from './game-config.js';

/** Shared five-frame/eight-direction layout measured from the Sweeper sheets. */
export function createSweeper(label, source) {
  const rowEdges = [0, 220, 420, 620, 820, 1015, 1210, 1405, 1586];
  return {
    label, source, standard: true, contactDamage: 1,
    spriteSize: normalSpriteSize * sweeperSettings.sizeRatio,
    referenceSize: 160,
    rows: { down: 0, downLeft: 1, left: 2, upLeft: 3, up: 4, upRight: 5, right: 6, downRight: 7 },
    frameSequence: [0, 1, 2, 3, 4],
    layout: { columnEdges: [0, 198, 397, 595, 794, 992],
      rowEdges: Array.from({ length: 5 }, () => [...rowEdges]) },
    combatHitbox: combatHitboxes.mob, // Share Mob circle/center adjustments instead of duplicating them.
    x: 590, y: 260, direction: 'down', elapsed: 0, moving: false
  };
}
// Per-column row boundaries in SOURCE IMAGE pixels, measured from the sheet top.
// The imported rows are uneven: equal-height slicing cuts hair, feet, and halos.
// Each column has nine edges defining eight rows. Adjust an edge up/down to
// move the shared boundary between two rows; keep values in increasing order.
// Change columnEdges if horizontal frame cropping needs adjustment.
// Arona has a large left margin and narrower columns; its layout is independent.
// Optional footY values anchor visible feet instead of transparent crop bottoms.
// Optional frames[row][column] overrides handle attack effects outside grid cells.
// anchorX is a SOURCE IMAGE coordinate: keep it on the tank, not the flash/flag.
// Packed right-cannon frames must stay inside their column to prevent neighbor bleed.
// Right-firing crops are shifted +18 source pixels; anchorX stays fixed.
export const spriteLayouts = {
  "plana": {
    "columnEdges": [
      0,
      198,
      397,
      595,
      794,
      992
    ],
    "rowEdges": [
      [
        0,
        198,
        392,
        589,
        786,
        991,
        1185,
        1378,
        1586
      ],
      [
        0,
        198,
        392,
        588,
        787,
        991,
        1185,
        1377,
        1586
      ],
      [
    contactDamageMultiplier: elite && !dedicatedMega ? 2 : 1,
    ...(profile ? { hp: Math.round(maxHp), maxHp: Math.round(maxHp), perTypeStats: true,
      contactDamage: scaled.atk, expReward: profile.expValue,
      movementSpeedMultiplier: scaled.spd * playerSettings.speed / playerSettings.movementBase } : {})
  };
}

/** Pick from the configured standard enemy pool while keeping Mob most common. */
export function chooseStandardEnemy(random = Math.random, elapsedSeconds = 0) {
  const entries = Object.entries(standardEnemyWeights).filter(([type, weight]) => {
    const profile = enemyTypeStats[type];
    return weight > 0 && (!profile || (elapsedSeconds >= profile.spawnStartSeconds && elapsedSeconds < profile.spawnEndSeconds));
  });
  let roll = random() * entries.reduce((sum, [, weight]) => sum + weight, 0);
  for (const [type, weight] of entries) { roll -= weight; if (roll < 0) return type; }
  return entries.at(-1)?.[0] ?? null;
}

/** Follow the active character through positive and negative world coordinates. */
function updateCamera(delta = 0) {
  // Ease the retained screen anchor toward center after changing map axes.
  // World coordinates never change; the entire scene follows the same camera.
  const blend = 1 - Math.exp(-cameraRecenterSpeed * delta);
  cameraAnchor.x += (canvas.width / 2 - cameraAnchor.x) * blend;
  cameraAnchor.y += (canvas.height / 2 - cameraAnchor.y) * blend;
  camera.x = characters[selected].x - cameraAnchor.x;
  camera.y = characters[selected].y - cameraAnchor.y;
  clampStripCamera(maps[currentMap], camera, canvas.width, canvas.height);
  if (currentMap === 'fourth') {
    const map = maps.fourth;
    camera.x = Math.max(map.originX, Math.min(map.originX + islandWidth - canvas.width, camera.x));
    camera.y = Math.max(map.originY, Math.min(map.originY + islandHeight - canvas.height, camera.y));
  }
}

/** Compute only visible tile indices, including negative indices left of origin. */
function getVisibleTileRange(cameraX, viewportWidth, tileWidth) {
  return {
    first: Math.floor(cameraX / tileWidth),
    last: Math.ceil((cameraX + viewportWidth) / tileWidth) - 1
  };
}

/** Render a bounded number of tiles from one shared image, however far we travel. */
// Row input order used by the test controls; indices are zero-based.
const directions = ['down', 'downLeft', 'left', 'upLeft', 'up', 'upRight', 'right', 'downRight'];

/** Build a configurable-column/eight-row grid within editable source-image margins. */
export function makeGrid(width, height, margins, columns = 5) {
  if (!Number.isInteger(columns) || columns < 1 || columns > 64) {
    throw new Error('Columns must be an integer from 1 to 64.');
  }
  const { left, top, right, bottom } = margins;
  if (Object.values(margins).some(value => !Number.isFinite(value) || value < 0) ||
      left + right >= width || top + bottom >= height) {
    throw new Error('Margins must leave a non-empty sprite area.');
  }
  const columnEdges = Array.from({ length: columns + 1 }, (_, i) => left + (width - left - right) * i / columns);
  const edges = Array.from({ length: 9 }, (_, i) => top + (height - top - bottom) * i / 8);
  return { columnEdges, rowEdges: Array.from({ length: columns }, () => [...edges]) };
}

/** Decode a local image before replacing the currently working sprite. */
function loadImage(url) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const image = new Image();
    image.onload = () => resolve(image);
    image.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Cannot read this image. Choose a PNG, WebP, or JPEG sprite sheet.'));
    image.src = url;
  });

/** Blend from the last visible pose without moving the character's world anchor. */
function beginPoseTransition(character) {
  if (character.transitionDuration && character.lastPose) {
    character.transition = { from: character.lastPose, elapsed: 0 };

import { stageProgressionSettings } from './game-config.js';

/** Progress the campaign in order, then choose a different available map per boss wave. */
export function nextStageAfterBoss(currentMap, endless, availableMaps, random = Math.random) {
  const settings = stageProgressionSettings;
  const regular = settings.order.filter(id => availableMaps.includes(id));
  const index = settings.order.indexOf(currentMap);
  if (!endless && index >= 0 && index < settings.order.length - 1) {
    const next = settings.order.slice(index + 1).find(id => availableMaps.includes(id));
    return { mapId: next || currentMap, endless: false, secretRolled: false };
  }
  const secretRolled = random() < settings.secretChance;
  if (secretRolled && availableMaps.includes(settings.secretStageId)) {
    return { mapId: settings.secretStageId, endless: true, secretRolled: true };
  }
  // An unimplemented secret stage falls back to a real map, without creating assets or routes.
  const choices = regular.filter(id => id !== currentMap);
  const pool = choices.length ? choices : regular;
  return { mapId: pool[Math.floor(random() * pool.length)] || currentMap,
    endless: true, secretRolled };
}

export { bossCatchupSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { isBossEnemy, enemyViewportDistance } from './world-state.js';
import { statMultiplier } from './combat-stats.js';



/** Boost distant chasing bosses above player speed until their sprite re-enters view. */
export function updateBossCatchup(enemy, player, camera, width, height, baseSpeed = 180) {
  if (!isBossEnemy(enemy)) return;
  const distance = enemyViewportDistance(enemy, camera, width, height);
  if (distance > bossCatchupSettings.distance) enemy.catchingUp = true;
  if (distance === 0) enemy.catchingUp = false;
  const playerSpeed = baseSpeed * (player.movementSpeedMultiplier || 1) * statMultiplier(player, 'spdPercent');
  const enemySpeed = baseSpeed * (enemy.movementSpeedMultiplier || 1) * statMultiplier(enemy, 'spdPercent');
  enemy.catchupSpeed = enemy.catchingUp && enemy.ai && enemy.behavior === 'chase'
    ? Math.max(enemySpeed * bossCatchupSettings.baseMultiplier,
      playerSpeed * bossCatchupSettings.playerMultiplier + bossCatchupSettings.extraSpeed) : 0;
}

import { scoreFormula } from './game-config.js';

/** Count real defeats and snapshot scores without inventing leaderboard/results placement. */
export function createRunScore() {
  let counts = { enemyDefeated: 0, miniBossDefeated: 0, bossDefeated: 0 };
  let endlessDefeatRecorded = false;
  const results = [];
  return {
    recordDefeat(enemy) {
      counts.enemyDefeated++;
      if (enemy.miniBoss) counts.miniBossDefeated++;
      else if (enemy.boss || (enemy.boss !== false && ['iroha','shiroko'].includes(enemy.type))) counts.bossDefeated++;
    },
    complete({ character, elapsedSeconds, stage, endless = false, hardcore = false }) {
      if (endless && endlessDefeatRecorded) return null;
      if (endless) endlessDefeatRecorded = true;
      const result = Object.freeze({ ...scoreFormula({ ...counts, playerLevel: character.level || 1,
        elapsedSeconds, hardcore }), ...counts, character: character.label, stage,
      }
    }
    if (layer === 'normal') drawGachaDeaths(context, camera, canvas.width, canvas.height, false);
  }

  refresh();
  /** Clean up before spawning, or immediately after entering another map. */
  function cleanup() {
    let removed = trimEnemyPopulation(getPlayer());
    removed += despawnDistantEnemies(camera, canvas.width, canvas.height, isPlacementClear);
    if (removed) refresh();
    return removed;
  }

  return { update, draw: () => draw('normal'), drawSpecials: () => draw('special'), drawBosses: () => draw('boss'), refresh, cleanup, getEnemies: records,
    slotsRemaining: () => Math.max(0, cap - records().length),
    spawnCampaignEncounter: row => {
      const type=row.enemies[0],size=characters[type]?.spriteSize||normalSpriteSize;
      const margin=size/2+32,player=getPlayer();
      const spots=[[camera.x-margin,player.y],[camera.x+canvas.width+margin,player.y],
        [player.x,camera.y-margin],[player.x,camera.y+canvas.height+margin]];
      return spots.some(([x,y])=>spawn(x,y,{type,variant:'normal',ai:true,behavior:'chase',automatic:true,
        campaignEntry:{row,mega:false,scheduled:true}}));
    },
    spawnBoss: (type, x, y) => spawn(x, y, { type, variant: 'normal', ai: true, behavior: 'chase', automatic: true }),
    spawnEnemy: (x, y, forcedType, eventKey) => {
      if(campaignActive() && !forcedType) {
        const entry=getCampaignSpawn();
        return entry ? spawn(x,y,{type:entry.type,variant:'normal',ai:true,behavior:'chase',automatic:true,campaignEntry:entry}) : false;
      }
      if (forcedType === 'midori') return spawn(x, y, { type: 'midori', eventKey, ai: true, behavior: 'chase', automatic: true });
      // Harmless enemies now use scheduled rolls, never ordinary kill/arrival rolls.
      const type = chooseStandardEnemy(Math.random, getStageSeconds(), getStageId());
      return type ? spawn(x, y, { type, eventKey, variant: 'random', ai: true, behavior: 'chase', automatic: true }) : false;
    } };
}

/** A wave ends only on an actual boss defeat with no living or queued bosses remaining. */
export function bossWaveIsDefeated(defeatedEnemy, enemies, hasQueuedBosses) {
  const boss = enemy => enemy.boss === true || ['shiroko', 'iroha'].includes(enemy.type);
  return boss(defeatedEnemy) && !hasQueuedBosses && !enemies.some(boss);
}
